chapter_title: Concerning the Garment of the Waters: how great is
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶6:** At the time when the Divine Human cloth ed itself with the spiritual faculties of good and truth, and stood firm against the original enmity that had arisen in the realm of fals ity, it opposed those great and powerful ev ils. They are without measure — their domin ion exce eds what thousands upon thousands of degrees of spiritual extent can rec kon. At the beginning , when the Divine Human spread the combat against them, it presented to them the ard or of divine love and the force of spiritual understanding ; and afterward it extended external truths to the powers of spiritual death . And those ruling evils received and consumed those tru ths, per verting them in wardly. Abundant tru ths flowed forth from the external form of truth , and streams of doctrine proceeded out ward . The reception of those ev ils — the agents of destruction — labored to draw those truths into themselves and bring them forth inv erted .

**¶7:** There were seven streams — corresponding to the full ness of rational understanding as it is known even in the natural world — flowing into the reception of each ruling evil; yet they could never satisfy a single interior will, never fill it , because when truth descends into the interior will of self -love, the burning desire and consuming heat of that love destro ys it. Those ruling evils were ins atiable; they were never empt ied of their cr aving; throughout all the states of their existence, this was so .

**¶8:** The scope of that stream of doctrine was multiplied sev enfold — that is, brought to complete full ness — as those tru ths flowed through the whole external form of those perv erted states into what they are now.

**¶9 :** Such is the magnitude of the spiritual combat, since it has engaged these monstrous falsities born of destruction — the vast dist ort ions of evil. Behold, they are entwined and bound and rest rained by divine order in every region of the spiritual world . They are hidden , not made manifest before the perception of any prop rial mind dwelling in the realm of spiritual death. Yet these ruling evils will be revealed . Everything belonging to the proprium — the entire universe of what is merely one's own — will be destroyed and dissolved; all of it will pass away. It will be und one by the voice of divine judgment , which is mightier than divine truth in its power to sh atter.

**¶10:** Now, as even the smallest stream of natural understanding is r eckoned as nearly nothing before the vast ness of those spiritual tru ths of which I have spoken : the rational knowledge men possess on earth — even what appears as their greatest river of understanding — is but one stream drawn from thousands upon thousands of streams of truth that flow from interior re alities never yet disclosed .

**¶11:** Consider the full measure of the faculties of divine truth . Consider the stature of the Divine Human who bore them within Himself. Consider how great is that Divine Power, active and living , whom these tru ths served — and how far that Power exce eds even the infinite capacity of the Divine Human who cloth ed Himself in external tru ths of such imm eas urable scope ; and how much was thereby accomplished .

---

*A note on method :* The " rulers drinking waters " is a striking image of evil appropri ating truth and inver ting it — closely parallel to what Swedenborg describes as the prof an ation of truth, where fals ity cons umes genuine doctrine and turns it to its own burning ends . The sev enfold rivers entering each ruler 's " mouth" correspond to the complete reception of truth into a will governed entirely by self-love, where it is ann ihilated by the fire of that love. The Tigris, named explicitly , serves in the original layer as it does in Genesis — a single visible stream of rational understanding representing , by correspondence , the me rest fraction of the infinite doc trinal rivers flowing from the Divine.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: How great is the power of the garment of the waters? How far shall [it extend]? That it should enter with the roar of its flood and fill this river Tigris in its vastness like the mighty sea! It has carried waves from river bank to bank, and run from wall to wall. The source from which all these waters burst forth, how great will it be? For they come and come each year at their appointed season!

[At] the time when the First Man assumed the elements, and stood [fi]rm against the first enmity that had come about in the darkness, he defied these great and powerful rulers. They are immeasurable, greater than the extent or size of thousands and ten thousands of parasangs. At the start, when he spread the fight against them, he gave them fire and wind; and afterwards he gave the garment of the waters to the rulers of death. So they, the rulers, drank in and consumed those waters. Many [waters] poured forth from the garment of waters [, whence] the rivers flow. The mouth of the rulers [consumed] those [waters], the warriors of destruction [received them,] laboured and brought them forth.

There were seven (rivers), like the great river Tigris [that you] see, flowing in to the mouth of each one of them, as they shall not [suffice] to a single stomach, to their fill; because in turn the descent to its stomach shall burn them with its fire and heat. Those rulers were like the [depths] of [the abyss]; they were not emptied; rain and [flood poured upon them all] their existent days.
The measure of that river was expanded seven times, as they flow [through the whole] of the body of the [rulers. These] waters [are what you behold] now.

Now, as this small stream is reckoned [as nothing] before the vastness of these waters. For only one river from thousands of rivers of water, from the secrets that are not revealed, is the river Tigris upon the earth.

[This] is how great a struggle, since it has [subdued] these creatures of destruction, the mighty giants. Behold, they are entwined, bound, and [restrained] in every place. They are hidden, not revealed before the eyes of every flesh that exists on the land of death [and darkness]. These rulers [shall be] revealed. The entire universe of flesh will be destroyed and dissolved [at the end]; all pass away [and perish]. They will be destroyed with their angry voice, which is mightier than the thunder.
